scope: Original sound set for the goreme slot: base ("Şafak") / idle / feature ("Şafak Şöleni") themes, dawn-valley ambience, feature intro, retrigger (+5), feature outro, total-win fanfare, win tiers 1–4 + max (heads, count-up beds, tier-ups, landings), 5 multiplier callout classes (≥×10 with its own burner-roar sound), reel spin/stop per reel, symbol land, balloon land by multiplier class (4), ways highlight graded 0–3, burner (lift), wind gust left/right and calm breeze, balloon merge (+ big merge ≥×10), fly-away, mooring (rope creak + chime), sky multiplier ticks, sun scatter 1–6 + tease + trigger, +5 spins, count-up ticks/ding, UI effects, three wordless voice placeholders and an 18-line recorded voice-bank slot (files not generated yet). Presentation only; nothing reads or changes a result.
originality: All music and effects are original note data and code synthesis (lib/slot-audio/scores/goreme.ts, sfx/goreme.ts, synth/goreme.ts; kanun, ney, bağlama, frame drum, darbuka, zil, choir, pads, bass, sparkles, whoosh, riser and the vox placeholder from the shared kit, the bağlama re-tuned to F as the `dawnSaz` voice). No samples, no recordings, no third-party melodies or motifs; no existing game, film or song imitated. The burner, wind, balloon merge, rope creak, brass chime and the bird chirps of the ambience are synthesized from noise, resonators and FM sweeps.

musicDirection.base: F Acemaşiran colour (F G A Bb C D E), 72 BPM, 12 bars = 40 s loop; the signature "lift" motif C–D–F answered by a slow fall to F; F-tuned bağlama lead with tremolo, kanun arpeggios, ney answer and B section over a warm pad, bendir-like frame drum.
musicDirection.feature: "Şafak Şöleni": G Mahur colour (G A B C D E F#), a whole tone above the base, 100 BPM, 16 bars = 38.4 s loop; kanun riff, off-beat lute strums, darbuka dum–tek with frame drum and zil, ney and wordless choir soaring to G6.
musicDirection.celebrations: Shared key ladder from F at 120 BPM: Büyük F → Mega G → Süper A → Efsane C → Azami D; stingers end on whole beats of the bar grid, tier-ups land on the beat (planTierUp).
musicDirection.otherGames: Ebru G Rast / A Uşşak, Tarhun A/D Hicaz, Cezeri C Nikriz/Çargah, Asena E Hüseyni / B Kürdi — Göreme uses none of them.

environment.runtime: Node 24 (tsx), single thread, cloud container 4 vCPU shared with other agents

method: Production render code (render.ts renderScore / renderSfx: seeded synthesis, per-stem loudness balancing, crest control, reverb send, loop tail folding, master EQ, loudness normalisation and look-ahead limiter at −1.6 dBFS) run in Node. Node has no OfflineAudioContext, so the harness supplies a minimal stand-in that performs the same ConvolverNode operation (normalize=false, stereo impulse, L*irL and R*irR) by FFT convolution; everything else is the shipped code path. Measurements with lib/slot-audio/synth/master.ts: BS.1770 integrated / momentary / short-term loudness, 4× oversampled true peak, sample peak, loop seam statistic (step last→first sample against every sample step of the loop), stereo correlation, spectral centroid; 16-bit TPDF WAV export.
commands: bash scripts/use-node.sh ./node_modules/.bin/tsx <scratchpad>/goreme-audio/measure.mts <scratchpad>/goreme-audio all   (from apps/web; harness kept in the scratchpad, not in the repo)
node <scratchpad>/goreme-audio/lab-check.mjs http://localhost:3031   (headless Chromium against the running next dev server, /lab/goreme-art)

voice.layout: public/audio/voice/goreme/<tr|en>/<stem>.mp3 (voice-locale: Turkish site language → tr, every other language → en)
voice.missingBehaviour: The hook loads the bank with requireVersion: a folder without mp3 files has no entry in voice-version.generated.ts (scripts/build-audio-worker.mjs), so no request is made; every line falls back to its wordless placeholder (vo-hum / vo-rise / vo-joy) or, for lift / wind / merge / feature-start / x2-9, to the effect alone. When files are added and the build script runs, the folder gets a version and the lines play (tested with a fake fetch).
voice.policy: Shared voice-policy.ts (Key moments default: tier, feature, callouts ≥×10; lift / wind / merge / sun-tease / moor / sky-10 are "moments" heard at Full only; nice is ambient).
voice.tierLines: Büyük, Mega, Süper → win-big; Efsane, Azami → win-epic (the script has two tier lines; a climb inside the same line stays wordless).

Measured in Node with an FFT stand-in for the browser ConvolverNode (same operation, not the browser's implementation); the lab-page run below exercises the real worker and OfflineAudioContext path in Chromium but its loudness was not measured there.
Instruments are synthesized approximations, not recordings; makam colours are 12-TET approximations (no quarter tones).
Voice lines do not exist yet (credit approval pending); the game plays wordless placeholders. No Higgsfield credit was spent.
Very short effects (tick, click) read under their momentary class target because they are shorter than the 400 ms window (same as the other sets).
The live master limiter is the shared DynamicsCompressor, not a true-peak limiter (same as the other games); every rendered asset is below −1 dBTP.
